blocks.title: Key vocabulary
items: lexer — Recognises tokens from character stream.
code generation — Production of target instructions.
optimisation — Meaning-preserving transformation to improve an objective.

blocks.title: Lexical analysis
blocks.text: Characters become tokens such as identifiers, numbers and operators.

blocks.title: Syntax analysis
blocks.text: A parser checks grammar and builds structural representation.

blocks.title: Code generation and optimisation
blocks.text: Target code is produced; valid transformations improve performance while preserving meaning.

blocks.title: Worked example · Model answer
blocks.text: Lexer identifies identifier, assignment, identifier, plus, integer. Parser checks grammatical structure. The compiler creates suitable target instructions; optimisation might fold constants only where semantics permit. Check: link each claim to the scenario and use precise OCR terminology.
